gpu_stage_envelope.semantics: CUDA event envelopes, not kernel/SM busy time; approx_begin_us calibration uncertainty is recorded per event

span_event_count_per_device_contract.note: No hard-coded V392 event count; report actual R397 period-1 spans and compare only against same-scope V392 first32K envelopes.

selected_window.time_domain: runtime monotonic_us affine-mapped from owner start/stop brackets

kernel_intervals.classification_basis: kernel name prefix/token heuristics; unknown names retained, names may be truncated and family assignment can be incomplete

concurrent_gpu_kernel_counts.semantics: Counts of overlapping CUPTI kernel intervals; not SM occupancy, kernel throughput, or GPU-busy percentage.

kernel_intervals.semantics: Per-device kernel interval union and concurrent event counts are CUPTI kernel timeline measurements, not SM occupancy or throughput.

limits: Kernel interval union and concurrency counts are not SM occupancy or GPU-busy percentages.
Classification uses recognizable kernel-name tokens; unknown names remain listed, and name truncation can produce unclassified events.
Kernel coverage is interpreted from the R398 host-child helper path/mode marker, not from symbol names.
Owner API interval union overlaps GPU activity; window-minus-union is unassigned, not attributed to PLE.

This captured trace contains 317846 kernel and 283904 runtime API records. Full child tracing can perturb host graph-launch/instantiation cost; traced API timings are diagnostic, not production wall-cost attribution.

helper_activation.coverage_note: R398 host-child direct launch should expose internal child kernel activities. This is based on helper path and launch-mode markers, not kernel symbol names.

comparison_with_v392_first32k.same_scope: first 32K target chunk only; diagnostic CUPTI/API and stage envelopes, never throughput
comparison_with_v392_first32k.warmth_note: V397 diagnostic follows a clean 64K on the same long-lived model/context; graph variants may be warm, while bank reset clears prompt KV. V392 also had a prior clean request; treat graph-cache state as context, not prompt KV reuse.

scheduler_stage_envelopes.semantics: CUDA event envelopes only; not kernel-busy/SM metrics

comparison_with_v392_first32k.warning: V392 used the device-tail parent path and did not expose child kernels. Differences in CUPTI kernel count/families are coverage changes as well as runtime changes; do not treat as isolated speed gain.

interpretation_limits: Diagnostic 32K is not compared as the primary prefill speed against V386 clean 64K; the primary speed row is V397 clean 64K versus V386/V373 clean.
Diagnostic 32K graph variants may be warm from the preceding clean 64K, while prompt KV is cleared before each scenario.
R398 host-child launch mode should expose internal kernel activity; validate helper mode marker and classify by kernel names. Unknown names stay visible and truncated name count is reported.
Kernel interval unions and concurrent-kernel counts are not SM occupancy or GPU-busy percentages.
V392 comparison is same-scope diagnostic first32K, not an uninstrumented throughput comparison; V392 parent-only kernel coverage differs from V397 internal-kernel coverage.
